requirements.text: In an eclipse plugin, there are applications with a name and an author
In an eclipse plugin, extension points have a name
In an eclipse plugin, descriptions have an xml schema
Each eclipse plugin has an id and a version
This fragment describe Library class in the EclipsePlugIn package. It is a class with only a name and no relationship
In an eclipse plugin, applications are composed by at least one extension point
In an eclipse plugin, extension points are linked to exactly one application
In an eclipse plugin, extension points are linked to exactly one plugin
In an eclipse plugin, descriptions may have extension points
In an eclipse plugin, extensions are configured into one extension point
Eclipse plugins configure one or more extensions
Eclipse plugins may require other plugins
In an eclipse plugin, a library is associated to exactly one plugin
In an eclipse plugin, each class has exactly one librairy
